The main takeaway from our work is that

the formation of an artificial base pair can be achieved using a modified purine nucleoside triphosphate, which opens the door to the use of this modified nucleotide as a building block in DNA synthesis.
artificial base pairs with high stability can indeed be formed in a highly efficient and specific way by DNA polymerases.
it is possible to design a nucleobase capable of forming a base pair with a modified purine, using a modified purine triphosphate, and that this can be achieved in a polymerase-mediated fashion.
